extracted.name: Spinach savoury muffins
extracted.description: Make these super green muffins as a first weaning food. Made with spinach, cheese and wholemeal flour, they're a good first food for babies from six months
instruction_lines: Set the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Put the spinach in a food processor and blitz until shredded (not puréed). Put in a bowl along with the grated cheese and dried thyme.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, and mix along with the yogurt. Mix in 2 tbsp milk, adding another tablespoon if needed.
Sieve the flour and baking powder over the bowl, then mix well to combine.
Butter a muffin tin, then spoon in the batter and bake for 20-25 mins. Cool.
